name: fxr_tele01c
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/tank/tele01c.state (disasm/notes/dragon_tank_bridge.md: Jackie's ch05 with the owner's story page spliced in, the bridge's two flags cleared): here the story page is the game's own -- Jackie's ch05 played through Lucca's rescue (fxr_jackie_rescue, storyline 2E, the bridge never visited: $7F0198 / $7F0199 bit 2 clear) -- then the ROM's loader onto the Dragon Tank's bridge, `--teleport 28 44 9 2 --method jmp --frames 60` (loc 01C), as the capture.
